en.title: Pale Colors of Love, Secret Pages
en.premise: In a quiet corner of the library, I found a handwritten map detailing "secret places around town," written by an unknown hand. Drawn to the lonely words inscribed upon it, I began leaving secret replies. What started as a simple note soon turns into a private correspondence with Minato, a boy who stands isolated from his classmates. Connected only by words, they begin to discover each other's loneliness and the faint colors of a budding romance as they visit the locations marked on the map.

zh.title: 淡色的恋情，秘密的篇章
zh.premise: 在图书馆的一个角落，我捡到了一张手写的地图，上面记录着“镇上的秘密地点”，却不知是谁所写。被其中记载的寂寞字句所吸引，我开始悄悄地写下回信，而这竟演变成了与班级里孤僻少年——凑君之间的秘密交流。仅凭文字相连的两人，在巡访地图上记载的地点时，逐渐察觉到了彼此的孤独与那抹淡然的爱慕之心。
